_source.title: 获取所有工程的 UUID
_source.remarks.text.0: 如若指定 `teamUuid`，则获取指定团队下的所有工程；
_source.remarks.text.1: 如若指定 `folderUuid`，则获取指定文件夹下的所有工程；
_source.remarks.text.2: `teamUuid`、`folderUuid` 需要且仅允许指定其一，如若都指定则只取 `folderUuid`；
_source.remarks.text.3: 如若指定 `workspaceUuid`，则在指定 Workspace 下获取指定团队/文件夹下的所有工程
_source.params.folderUuid: 文件夹 UUID，如若不指定，则默认为团队的根文件夹

title: Get the UUIDs of all projects
remarks.text.0: If `teamUuid` is specified, all projects under the specified team are obtained;
remarks.text.1: If `folderUuid` is specified, all projects under the specified folder are obtained;
remarks.text.2: `teamUuid`, `folderUuid` only one of them may be specified, if both are specified, only `folderUuid`;
remarks.text.3: If `workspaceUuid` is specified, all projects under the specified team/folder are obtained in the specified Workspace
params.folderUuid: Folder UUID. If not specified, it defaults to the root folder of the team
